mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.order_no AS orderNo, w.customer_id AS customerId, w.customer_name AS customerName, w.customer_mobile AS customerMobile, w.barcode, w.product_code AS productCode, w.product_name AS productName, w.product_model AS productModel, w.machine_no AS machineNo, w.brand_code AS brandCode, w.service_mode AS serviceMode, w.warranty_status AS warrantyStatus, w.fault_desc AS faultDesc, w.fault_remark AS faultRemark, w.sender_name AS senderName, w.sender_mobile AS senderMobile, w.sender_address AS senderAddress, w.send_express_no AS sendExpressNo, w.main_status AS mainStatus, w.evaluate_status AS evaluateStatus, w.current_accept_subject_type AS currentAcceptSubjectType, w.current_accept_company_id AS currentAcceptCompanyId, cac.company_name AS currentAcceptCompanyName, w.assigned_user_id AS assignedUserId, su.real_name AS assignedUserName, w.create_company_id AS createCompanyId, cc.company_name AS createCompanyName, w.hq_company_id AS hqCompanyId, hc.company_name AS hqCompanyName, w.has_transfer AS hasTransfer, w.transfer_count AS transferCount, w.return_method AS returnMethod, w.return_express_no AS returnExpressNo, w.close_reason AS closeReason, w.completed_time AS completedTime, w.closed_time AS closedTime, w.create_time AS createTime FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_company cac ON w.current_accept_company_id = cac.id LEFT JOIN sys_company cc ON w.create_company_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN sys_company hc ON w.hq_company_id = hc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON w.assigned_user_id = su.id WHERE w.id = #{id}

SELECT p.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, p.subject_type AS subjectType, p.participate_type AS participateType, p.is_current_handler AS isCurrentHandler, p.is_readonly AS isReadonly, p.first_participate_time AS firstParticipateTime, p.last_participate_time AS lastParticipateTime FROM work_order_participant p LEFT JOIN sys_company c ON p.company_id = c.id WHERE p.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY p.first_participate_time ASC, p.company_id ASC
